name: Full backup for q∗ from an estimated model
tex: Q(s, a) \leftarrow \sum_{s', r}\hat{p}(s', r|s, a)\Big[r + \gamma\max_{a'}Q(s', a')\Big]
intuition: Average the one-step lookahead over every possible outcome, weighted by its estimated probability.
significance: Exact given the successors' values, but it evaluates all b successors.

name: Sample backup for q∗ (Q-learning-like)
tex: Q(s, a) \leftarrow Q(s, a) + \alpha\Big[R + \gamma\max_{a'}Q(S', a') - Q(s, a)\Big]

symbols.meaning: one sampled next state and reward (from the model)

intuition: Move toward the lookahead through one sampled outcome.
significance: With a deterministic model and α = 1 it equals the full backup (8.1).
pitfalls: Affected by sampling error when there are many possible next states.
